name: Sprouted Moong Breakfast Bowl
ingredients: ½ cup plain unsweetened soy yogurt
steps: Steam or boil sprouts for 5–7 minutes until piping hot and tender; cool slightly. Do not use raw sprouts for people at higher risk of foodborne illness.
Whisk soy yogurt with lemon, cumin, salt and pepper to make a dressing.
Divide warm sprouts between two bowls. Add cucumber, tomato and carrot.
Spoon over the dressing and toss lightly.
Finish with coriander and sunflower seeds. Serve promptly.
note: Sprouts are perishable. Refrigerate promptly and cook thoroughly rather than serving raw, especially for pregnant, older or immunocompromised people.
